title: Bougainville Island - Wikipedia
text: Non-Austronesian languages are spoken on the main island of Bougainville. These include Rotokas, a language with a very small inventory of phonemes, Eivo, Terei, Keriaka, Naasioi (Kieta), Nagovisi, Siwai (Motuna), Baitsi (sometimes considered a dialect of Siwai), and Uisai.
